verses.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

verses.web: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
verses.kjv: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.

verses.web: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
verses.kjv: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

verses.web: The voice of Yahweh breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.kjv: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.web: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
verses.kjv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.web: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
verses.kjv: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.

verses.web: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.kjv: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.web: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
verses.kjv: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

verses.web: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
verses.kjv: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.

verses.web: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
verses.kjv: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.

verses.web: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.kjv: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.web: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
verses.kjv: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.web: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.kjv: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.web: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
verses.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.web: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verses.kjv: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

verses.web: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
verses.kjv: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.web: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
verses.kjv: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

verses.web: I cried to you, Yahweh. To Yahweh I made supplication:
verses.kjv: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.

verses.web: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
verses.kjv: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.web: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”
verses.kjv: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.

verses.web: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
verses.kjv: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.web: To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
verses.kjv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

verses.web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

verses.web: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

verses.web: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
verses.kjv: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.web: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
verses.kjv: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

verses.web: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.
verses.kjv: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

verses.web: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.
verses.kjv: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.

verses.web: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
verses.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

verses.web: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
verses.kjv: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

verses.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

verses.web: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
verses.kjv: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

verses.web: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
verses.kjv: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

verses.web: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
verses.kjv: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

verses.web: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
verses.kjv: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.web: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”
verses.kjv: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.

verses.web: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
verses.kjv: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

verses.web: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

verses.web: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
verses.kjv: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

verses.web: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
verses.kjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

verses.web: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
verses.kjv: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

verses.web: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.web: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

verses.web: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
verses.kjv: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

verses.web: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
verses.kjv: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.web: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.

verses.web: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.kjv: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.web: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.kjv: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.web: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
verses.kjv: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

verses.web: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
verses.kjv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.web: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.kjv: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.web: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
verses.kjv: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.web: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.kjv: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.web: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
verses.kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

verses.web: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
verses.kjv: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

verses.web: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.

verses.web: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
verses.kjv: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.web: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
verses.kjv: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

verses.web: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
verses.kjv: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

verses.web: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.kjv: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.

verses.web: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
verses.kjv: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

verses.web: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made; all their army by the breath of his mouth.
verses.kjv: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.web: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.kjv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

verses.web: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.kjv: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.web: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.kjv: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.web: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.kjv: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

verses.web: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.kjv: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.web: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.kjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.web: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
verses.kjv: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

verses.web: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.kjv: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.web: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
verses.kjv: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

verses.web: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.kjv: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

verses.web: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
verses.kjv: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

verses.web: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness;
verses.kjv: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

verses.web: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
verses.kjv: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.web: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
verses.kjv: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.

verses.web: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.kjv: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.web: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
verses.kjv: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

verses.web: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
verses.kjv: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.web: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it, and be glad.
verses.kjv: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.web: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.
verses.kjv: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.web: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.kjv: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.web: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
verses.kjv: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

verses.web: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.kjv: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.web: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
verses.kjv: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

verses.web: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
verses.kjv: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

verses.web: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
verses.kjv: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.web: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
verses.kjv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.

verses.web: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.web: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.kjv: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

verses.web: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
verses.kjv: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.web: Depart from evil, and do good. seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.web: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
verses.kjv: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

verses.web: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
verses.kjv: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.web: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.kjv: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.web: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verses.kjv: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.web: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
verses.kjv: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.

verses.web: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
verses.kjv: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.web: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.kjv: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

verses.web: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
verses.kjv: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

verses.web: Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.
verses.kjv: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

verses.web: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
verses.kjv: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

verses.web: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
verses.kjv: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

verses.web: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

verses.web: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.
verses.kjv: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase them.

verses.web: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.
verses.kjv: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.

verses.web: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
verses.kjv: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

verses.web: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
verses.kjv: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

verses.web: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.kjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.web: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
verses.kjv: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

verses.web: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
verses.kjv: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

verses.web: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
verses.kjv: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

verses.web: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.
verses.kjv: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

verses.web: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
verses.kjv: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

verses.web: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
verses.kjv: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

verses.web: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.kjv: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.web: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
verses.kjv: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

verses.web: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.
verses.kjv: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

verses.web: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.
verses.kjv: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

verses.web: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
verses.kjv: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

verses.web: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
verses.kjv: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

verses.web: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
verses.kjv: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.web: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
verses.kjv: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

verses.web: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
verses.kjv: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.web: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
verses.kjv: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

verses.web: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.
verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

verses.web: Let them shout for joy and be glad, who favor my righteous cause. Yes, let them say continually, “Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”
verses.kjv: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

verses.web: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
verses.kjv: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.web: An oracle is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
verses.kjv: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.web: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
verses.kjv: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

verses.web: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
verses.kjv: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

verses.web: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
verses.kjv: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

verses.web: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.kjv: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.web: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.
verses.kjv: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.

verses.web: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
verses.kjv: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

verses.web: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
verses.kjv: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

verses.web: For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.
verses.kjv: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

verses.web: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.kjv: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.web: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.kjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

verses.web: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.kjv: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

verses.web: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
verses.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.web: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
verses.kjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

verses.web: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
verses.kjv: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

verses.web: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.kjv: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

verses.web: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
verses.kjv: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

verses.web: he will make your righteousness go out as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
verses.kjv: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

verses.web: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
verses.kjv: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

verses.web: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret, it leads only to evildoing.
verses.kjv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

verses.web: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
verses.kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

verses.web: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
verses.kjv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

verses.web: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.kjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.web: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
verses.kjv: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

verses.web: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.kjv: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

verses.web: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
verses.kjv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

verses.web: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
verses.kjv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.web: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.kjv: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

verses.web: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
verses.kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

verses.web: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
verses.kjv: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.web: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.web: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
verses.kjv: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

verses.web: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
verses.kjv: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

verses.web: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
verses.kjv: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.web: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
verses.kjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.

verses.web: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
verses.kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.

verses.web: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
verses.kjv: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.web: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His seed is blessed.
verses.kjv: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

verses.web: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.web: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.kjv: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.web: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.web: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
verses.kjv: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

verses.web: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
verses.kjv: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

verses.web: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.
verses.kjv: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

verses.web: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.kjv: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.web: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
verses.kjv: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

verses.web: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
verses.kjv: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

verses.web: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.kjv: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.web: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
verses.kjv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

verses.web: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.kjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.web: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.kjv: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.web: Yahweh helps them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them, Because they have taken refuge in him.
verses.kjv: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.web: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
verses.kjv: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.web: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
verses.kjv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

verses.web: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.kjv: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.web: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
verses.kjv: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.web: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.
verses.kjv: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

verses.web: I am pained and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
verses.kjv: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

verses.web: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.kjv: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.web: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
verses.kjv: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.web: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
verses.kjv: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.web: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
verses.kjv: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.web: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
verses.kjv: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.web: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
verses.kjv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

verses.web: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
verses.kjv: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

verses.web: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.kjv: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

verses.web: For in you, Yahweh, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.
verses.kjv: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

verses.web: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
verses.kjv: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

verses.web: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
verses.kjv: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.web: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.kjv: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.web: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
verses.kjv: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.web: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
verses.kjv: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

verses.web: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
verses.kjv: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.

verses.web: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
verses.kjv: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

verses.web: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
verses.kjv: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

verses.web: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
verses.kjv: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

verses.web: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned: I spoke with my tongue:
verses.kjv: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

verses.web: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
verses.kjv: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.

verses.web: Behold, you have made my days hand breadths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

verses.web: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
verses.kjv: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

verses.web: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
verses.kjv: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

verses.web: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.web: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
verses.kjv: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

verses.web: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
verses.kjv: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

verses.web: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, You consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
verses.kjv: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

verses.web: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

verses.web: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more.”
verses.kjv: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.web: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
verses.kjv: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

verses.web: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
verses.kjv: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

verses.web: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
verses.kjv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

verses.web: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.kjv: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.web: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.kjv: Many, O Lord my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

verses.web: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
verses.kjv: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

verses.web: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
verses.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

verses.web: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
verses.kjv: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

verses.web: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
verses.kjv: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.

verses.web: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
verses.kjv: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.web: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
verses.kjv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.web: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
verses.kjv: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

verses.web: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.

verses.web: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.
verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.web: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.kjv: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”
verses.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

verses.web: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
verses.kjv: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.web: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.kjv: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.

verses.web: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
verses.kjv: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

verses.web: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
verses.kjv: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

verses.web: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
verses.kjv: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

verses.web: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
verses.kjv: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.web: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
verses.kjv: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

verses.web: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
verses.kjv: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

verses.web: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
verses.kjv: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

verses.web: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.kjv: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.web: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
verses.kjv: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

verses.web: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
verses.kjv: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

verses.web: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
verses.kjv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

verses.web: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
verses.kjv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

verses.web: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.kjv: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.web: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
verses.kjv: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.web: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
verses.kjv: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

verses.web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

verses.web: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
verses.kjv: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

verses.web: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
verses.kjv: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

verses.web: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.kjv: Yet the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

verses.web: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
verses.kjv: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.web: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
verses.kjv: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.web: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
verses.kjv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.web: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.kjv: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.web: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, To your tents.
verses.kjv: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

verses.web: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
verses.kjv: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

verses.web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.web: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
verses.kjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

verses.web: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
verses.kjv: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

verses.web: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
verses.kjv: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

verses.web: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
verses.kjv: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.web: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.
verses.kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.web: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.kjv: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.web: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
verses.kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

verses.web: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
verses.kjv: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

verses.web: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

verses.web: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

verses.web: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
verses.kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

verses.web: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
verses.kjv: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

verses.web: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.web: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.web: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
verses.kjv: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

verses.web: At the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.kjv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.web: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.
verses.kjv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

verses.web: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
verses.kjv: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

verses.web: Though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.kjv: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.web: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god;
verses.kjv: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.web: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.kjv: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

verses.web: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.web: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
verses.kjv: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

verses.web: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.web: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
verses.kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

verses.web: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
verses.kjv: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.

verses.web: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
verses.kjv: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.web: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
verses.kjv: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.web: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.
verses.kjv: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.web: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
verses.kjv: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

verses.web: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
verses.kjv: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

verses.web: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.kjv: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

verses.web: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
verses.kjv: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.web: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
verses.kjv: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

verses.web: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
verses.kjv: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.web: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
verses.kjv: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

verses.web: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
verses.kjv: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

verses.web: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
verses.kjv: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

verses.web: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
verses.kjv: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

verses.web: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
verses.kjv: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

verses.web: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.kjv: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

verses.web: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
verses.kjv: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

verses.web: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
verses.kjv: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

verses.web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.kjv: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.web: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
verses.kjv: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

verses.web: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
verses.kjv: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

verses.web: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
verses.kjv: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

verses.web: God is in her midst. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
verses.kjv: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

verses.web: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.
verses.kjv: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.kjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.web: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
verses.kjv: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

verses.web: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
verses.kjv: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

verses.web: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
verses.kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.kjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.web: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
verses.kjv: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

verses.web: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
verses.kjv: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

verses.web: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
verses.kjv: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.web: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.kjv: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

verses.web: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.kjv: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.web: Sing praise to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
verses.kjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

verses.web: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
verses.kjv: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

verses.web: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
verses.kjv: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

verses.web: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
verses.kjv: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

verses.web: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
verses.kjv: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

verses.web: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
verses.kjv: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.web: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
verses.kjv: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.web: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
verses.kjv: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

verses.web: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
verses.kjv: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

verses.web: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.kjv: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.web: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
verses.kjv: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.web: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
verses.kjv: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

verses.web: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the midst of your temple.
verses.kjv: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

verses.web: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.kjv: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.web: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of your judgments.
verses.kjv: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

verses.web: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
verses.kjv: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

verses.web: Mark well her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
verses.kjv: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

verses.web: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
verses.kjv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

verses.web: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
verses.kjv: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

verses.web: both low and high, rich and poor together.
verses.kjv: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

verses.web: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart shall utter understanding.
verses.kjv: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

verses.web: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will open my riddle on the harp.
verses.kjv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

verses.web: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
verses.kjv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

verses.web: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
verses.kjv: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.web: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
verses.kjv: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

verses.web: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
verses.kjv: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

verses.web: That he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
verses.kjv: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

verses.web: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.kjv: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.web: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
verses.kjv: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

verses.web: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.web: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.kjv: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.web: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
verses.kjv: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

verses.web: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
verses.kjv: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

verses.web: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased.
verses.kjv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.web: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away. His glory shall not descend after him.
verses.kjv: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

verses.web: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
verses.kjv: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

verses.web: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
verses.kjv: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

verses.web: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
verses.kjv: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

verses.web: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
verses.kjv: The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

verses.web: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
verses.kjv: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

verses.web: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
verses.kjv: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

verses.web: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
verses.kjv: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

verses.web: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
verses.kjv: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

verses.web: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
verses.kjv: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

verses.web: “Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
verses.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

verses.web: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
verses.kjv: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

verses.web: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
verses.kjv: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

verses.web: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
verses.kjv: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.web: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
verses.kjv: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

verses.web: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
verses.kjv: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.web: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.kjv: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.web: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
verses.kjv: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

verses.web: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
verses.kjv: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

verses.web: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
