verses.kjv: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

verses.web: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
verses.kjv: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

verses.web: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
verses.kjv: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

verses.web: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
verses.kjv: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

verses.web: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
verses.kjv: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

verses.web: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
verses.kjv: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

verses.web: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
verses.kjv: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

verses.web: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
verses.kjv: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

verses.web: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.web: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
verses.kjv: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.web: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
verses.kjv: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

verses.web: Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
verses.kjv: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

verses.web: Behold, I was born in iniquity. In sin my mother conceived me.
verses.kjv: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.web: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
verses.kjv: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

verses.web: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.kjv: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.web: Let me hear joy and gladness, That the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
verses.kjv: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

verses.web: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
verses.kjv: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

verses.web: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
verses.kjv: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.web: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your holy Spirit from me.
verses.kjv: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

verses.web: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.kjv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

verses.web: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.
verses.kjv: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

verses.web: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

verses.web: Lord, open my lips. My mouth shall declare your praise.
verses.kjv: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

verses.web: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
verses.kjv: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

verses.web: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
verses.kjv: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

verses.web: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.web: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

verses.web: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
verses.kjv: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

verses.web: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.kjv: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.web: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
verses.kjv: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

verses.web: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
verses.kjv: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

verses.web: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.kjv: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

verses.web: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
verses.kjv: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

verses.web: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
verses.kjv: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.web: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
verses.kjv: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

verses.web: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

verses.web: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.
verses.kjv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

verses.web: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
verses.kjv: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

verses.web: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
verses.kjv: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.web: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
verses.kjv: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

verses.web: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.
verses.kjv: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

verses.web: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.kjv: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.web: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
verses.kjv: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

verses.web: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.web: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
verses.kjv: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

verses.web: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
verses.kjv: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

verses.web: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
verses.kjv: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

verses.web: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.
verses.kjv: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

verses.web: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
verses.kjv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

verses.web: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
verses.kjv: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.web: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
verses.kjv: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.web: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
verses.kjv: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.web: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
verses.kjv: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.web: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.kjv: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.web: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
verses.kjv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.web: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
verses.kjv: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.web: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
verses.kjv: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

verses.web: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.kjv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.web: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
verses.kjv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

verses.web: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
verses.kjv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.web: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
verses.kjv: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.web: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
verses.kjv: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

verses.web: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
verses.kjv: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

verses.web: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwelling, in their midst.
verses.kjv: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.web: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
verses.kjv: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

verses.web: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
verses.kjv: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.web: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
verses.kjv: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

verses.web: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don’t fear God.
verses.kjv: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

verses.web: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
verses.kjv: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

verses.web: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
verses.kjv: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

verses.web: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
verses.kjv: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.web: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
verses.kjv: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

verses.web: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

verses.web: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
verses.kjv: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

verses.web: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
verses.kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

verses.web: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
verses.kjv: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

verses.web: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.kjv: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.web: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps, they are eager to take my life.
verses.kjv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

verses.web: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
verses.kjv: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

verses.web: You number my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
verses.kjv: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

verses.web: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.
verses.kjv: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

verses.web: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
verses.kjv: In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.

verses.web: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.kjv: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

verses.web: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
verses.kjv: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

verses.web: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

verses.web: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

verses.web: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
verses.kjv: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

verses.web: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
verses.kjv: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

verses.web: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.kjv: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.web: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into its midst themselves. Selah.
verses.kjv: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

verses.web: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
verses.kjv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

verses.web: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, psaltery and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
verses.kjv: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.web: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.web: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
verses.kjv: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

verses.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.web: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
verses.kjv: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

verses.web: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.kjv: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.web: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
verses.kjv: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

verses.web: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
verses.kjv: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

verses.web: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
verses.kjv: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

verses.web: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.

verses.web: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
verses.kjv: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.web: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
verses.kjv: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

verses.web: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
verses.kjv: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

verses.web: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;
verses.kjv: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.web: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
verses.kjv: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

verses.web: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.web: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.web: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.

verses.web: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
verses.kjv: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

verses.web: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
verses.kjv: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.web: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
verses.kjv: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.web: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
verses.kjv: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

verses.web: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
verses.kjv: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

verses.web: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
verses.kjv: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

verses.web: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
verses.kjv: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

verses.web: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
verses.kjv: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

verses.web: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
verses.kjv: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

verses.web: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.kjv: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.web: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
verses.kjv: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.web: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
verses.kjv: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

verses.web: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.kjv: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.web: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.kjv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

verses.web: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
verses.kjv: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

verses.web: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
verses.kjv: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.web: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
verses.kjv: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.web: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.kjv: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.web: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.web: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
verses.kjv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.web: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
verses.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

verses.web: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
verses.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.web: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
verses.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

verses.web: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.web: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.web: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
verses.kjv: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.web: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.kjv: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.web: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.kjv: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.web: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
verses.kjv: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.web: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
verses.kjv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.web: You will prolong the king’s life; his years shall be for generations.
verses.kjv: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

verses.web: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.kjv: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

verses.web: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
verses.kjv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

verses.web: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
verses.kjv: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

verses.web: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress— I will never be greatly shaken.
verses.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.web: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
verses.kjv: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

verses.web: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.kjv: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

verses.web: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
verses.kjv: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

verses.web: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
verses.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.web: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.kjv: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.web: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.kjv: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

verses.web: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
verses.kjv: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

verses.web: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
verses.kjv: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

verses.web: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
verses.kjv: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

verses.web: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
verses.kjv: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

verses.web: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
verses.kjv: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.web: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
verses.kjv: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

verses.web: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
verses.kjv: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

verses.web: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
verses.kjv: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

verses.web: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
verses.kjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

verses.web: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
verses.kjv: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

verses.web: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
verses.kjv: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

verses.web: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
verses.kjv: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

verses.web: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.kjv: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.web: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
verses.kjv: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

verses.web: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
verses.kjv: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

verses.web: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.kjv: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.web: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
verses.kjv: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

verses.web: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
verses.kjv: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

verses.web: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
verses.kjv: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.web: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
verses.kjv: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.web: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
verses.kjv: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

verses.web: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
verses.kjv: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

verses.web: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
verses.kjv: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

verses.web: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
verses.kjv: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.web: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
verses.kjv: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

verses.web: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. To you shall vows be performed.
verses.kjv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.web: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.
verses.kjv: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.web: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.
verses.kjv: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

verses.web: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

verses.web: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea;
verses.kjv: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

verses.web: Who by his power forms the mountains, having armed yourself with strength;
verses.kjv: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

verses.web: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
verses.kjv: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.web: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.
verses.kjv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.web: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
verses.kjv: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

verses.web: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
verses.kjv: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

verses.web: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
verses.kjv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.web: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
verses.kjv: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.web: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
verses.kjv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.web: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

verses.web: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
verses.kjv: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.web: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
verses.kjv: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

verses.web: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
verses.kjv: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

verses.web: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
verses.kjv: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

verses.web: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
verses.kjv: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.web: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
verses.kjv: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.web: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
verses.kjv: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.web: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
verses.kjv: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

verses.web: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
verses.kjv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.web: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
verses.kjv: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

verses.web: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
verses.kjv: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

verses.web: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
verses.kjv: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

verses.web: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
verses.kjv: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

verses.web: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
verses.kjv: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

verses.web: Come, and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
verses.kjv: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

verses.web: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
verses.kjv: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.web: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
verses.kjv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

verses.web: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
verses.kjv: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.web: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
verses.kjv: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

verses.web: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
verses.kjv: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

verses.web: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
verses.kjv: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

verses.web: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.web: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
verses.kjv: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

verses.web: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.web: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.kjv: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

verses.web: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.kjv: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

verses.web: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
verses.kjv: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

verses.web: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.kjv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.web: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
verses.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

verses.web: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
verses.kjv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.

verses.web: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.kjv: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

verses.web: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
verses.kjv: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

verses.web: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
verses.kjv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

verses.web: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.web: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

verses.web: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
verses.kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

verses.web: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
verses.kjv: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

verses.web: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
verses.kjv: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

verses.web: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
verses.kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

verses.web: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
verses.kjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

verses.web: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
verses.kjv: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

verses.web: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
verses.kjv: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.

verses.web: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
verses.kjv: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

verses.web: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among men, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
verses.kjv: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.

verses.web: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

verses.web: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
verses.kjv: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

verses.web: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
verses.kjv: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

verses.web: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;
verses.kjv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

verses.web: That you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
verses.kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

verses.web: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
verses.kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.web: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, in the midst of the ladies playing with tambourines,
verses.kjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.web: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
verses.kjv: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

verses.web: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.kjv: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

verses.web: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
verses.kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

verses.web: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
verses.kjv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

verses.web: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.
verses.kjv: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

verses.web: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
verses.kjv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

verses.web: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! Selah.
verses.kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

verses.web: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
verses.kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

verses.web: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
verses.kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

verses.web: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
verses.kjv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

verses.web: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
verses.kjv: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

verses.web: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.kjv: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.web: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
verses.kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.web: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
verses.kjv: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

verses.web: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
verses.kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

verses.web: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
verses.kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.web: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
verses.kjv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

verses.web: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
verses.kjv: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.

verses.web: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
verses.kjv: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.web: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
verses.kjv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.web: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
verses.kjv: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.web: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
verses.kjv: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

verses.web: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
verses.kjv: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.web: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.web: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
verses.kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.web: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
verses.kjv: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.web: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
verses.kjv: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

verses.web: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
verses.kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

verses.web: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
verses.kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

verses.web: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
verses.kjv: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.web: They also gave me gall for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.web: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
verses.kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

verses.web: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
verses.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.web: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
verses.kjv: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.web: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
verses.kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

verses.web: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
verses.kjv: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

verses.web: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
verses.kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

verses.web: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.web: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
verses.kjv: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.web: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.web: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
verses.kjv: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

verses.web: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
verses.kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

verses.web: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
verses.kjv: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.web: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
verses.kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

verses.web: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
verses.kjv: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.web: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.web: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.

verses.web: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

verses.web: Let them be turned because of their shame Who say, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.kjv: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

verses.web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
verses.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

verses.web: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
verses.kjv: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.

verses.web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
verses.kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

verses.web: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
verses.kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

verses.web: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

verses.web: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.web: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh; my confidence from my youth.
verses.kjv: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.

verses.web: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
verses.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

verses.web: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
verses.kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

verses.web: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.
verses.kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

verses.web: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
verses.kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

verses.web: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
verses.kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

verses.web: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
verses.kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

verses.web: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
verses.kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

verses.web: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

verses.web: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
verses.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

verses.web: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
verses.kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

verses.web: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
verses.kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

verses.web: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
verses.kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

verses.web: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
verses.kjv: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

verses.web: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
verses.kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

verses.web: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.kjv: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.web: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

verses.web: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

verses.web: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
verses.kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

verses.web: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
verses.kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

verses.web: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
verses.kjv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

verses.web: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
verses.kjv: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

verses.web: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
verses.kjv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

verses.web: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
verses.kjv: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

verses.web: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
verses.kjv: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

verses.web: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
verses.kjv: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

verses.web: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
verses.kjv: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

verses.web: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.kjv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

verses.web: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.web: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.kjv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.web: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
verses.kjv: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

verses.web: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
verses.kjv: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

verses.web: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
verses.kjv: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.web: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
verses.kjv: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

verses.web: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
verses.kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

verses.web: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
verses.kjv: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.web: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
verses.kjv: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

verses.web: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

verses.web: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
verses.kjv: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

verses.web: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
verses.kjv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

verses.web: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
verses.kjv: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

verses.web: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
verses.kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.web: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.web: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
verses.kjv: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

verses.web: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.kjv: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

verses.web: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
verses.kjv: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

verses.web: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
verses.kjv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

verses.web: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
verses.kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

verses.web: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.kjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

verses.web: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
verses.kjv: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

verses.web: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
verses.kjv: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

verses.web: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
verses.kjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

verses.web: Surely in vain I have cleansed my heart, and washed my hands in innocence,
verses.kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

verses.web: For all day long have I been plagued, and punished every morning.
verses.kjv: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

verses.web: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
verses.kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

verses.web: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;
verses.kjv: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

verses.web: Until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
verses.kjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

verses.web: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
verses.kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

verses.web: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
verses.kjv: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

verses.web: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
verses.kjv: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

verses.web: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
verses.kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

verses.web: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
verses.kjv: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

verses.web: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

verses.web: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

verses.web: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
verses.kjv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

verses.web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

verses.web: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
verses.kjv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

verses.web: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
verses.kjv: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.

verses.web: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.kjv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

verses.web: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
verses.kjv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

verses.web: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
verses.kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

verses.web: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
verses.kjv: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

verses.web: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
verses.kjv: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

verses.web: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
verses.kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

verses.web: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
verses.kjv: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

verses.web: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
verses.kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

verses.web: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
verses.kjv: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
