verses.web: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
verses.kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

verses.web: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it out of your pocket and consume them!
verses.kjv: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

verses.web: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.kjv: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.web: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
verses.kjv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

verses.web: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
verses.kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

verses.web: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
verses.kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

verses.web: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

verses.web: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
verses.kjv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

verses.web: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
verses.kjv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

verses.web: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
verses.kjv: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

verses.web: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
verses.kjv: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

verses.web: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
verses.kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

verses.web: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
verses.kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

verses.web: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
verses.kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

verses.web: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
verses.kjv: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

verses.web: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
verses.kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

verses.web: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
verses.kjv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

verses.web: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
verses.kjv: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

verses.web: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
verses.kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

verses.web: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
verses.kjv: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

verses.web: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
verses.kjv: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

verses.web: For in the hand of Yahweh there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
verses.kjv: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

verses.web: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.web: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
verses.kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

verses.web: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
verses.kjv: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

verses.web: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
verses.kjv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.web: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
verses.kjv: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

verses.web: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
verses.kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

verses.web: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
verses.kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.web: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.
verses.kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.web: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
verses.kjv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

verses.web: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
verses.kjv: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

verses.web: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
verses.kjv: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

verses.web: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
verses.kjv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

verses.web: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
verses.kjv: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

verses.web: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
verses.kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

verses.web: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
verses.kjv: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

verses.web: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.web: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

verses.web: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
verses.kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

verses.web: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.kjv: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.web: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
verses.kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

verses.web: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
verses.kjv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

verses.web: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
verses.kjv: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

verses.web: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
verses.kjv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

verses.web: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
verses.kjv: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

verses.web: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
verses.kjv: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

verses.web: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
verses.kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

verses.web: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
verses.kjv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

verses.web: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
verses.kjv: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

verses.web: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.kjv: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.web: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
verses.kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

verses.web: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
verses.kjv: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

verses.web: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
verses.kjv: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

verses.web: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
verses.kjv: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

verses.web: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.kjv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.web: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.kjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.web: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
verses.kjv: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

verses.web: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.kjv: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.web: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous works that he has done.
verses.kjv: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

verses.web: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
verses.kjv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

verses.web: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
verses.kjv: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

verses.web: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments,
verses.kjv: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

verses.web: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
verses.kjv: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

verses.web: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.kjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

verses.web: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
verses.kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

verses.web: They forgot his doings, his wondrous works that he had shown them.
verses.kjv: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

verses.web: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.web: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
verses.kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

verses.web: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
verses.kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.web: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
verses.kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

verses.web: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.web: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
verses.kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

verses.web: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
verses.kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

verses.web: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.kjv: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

verses.web: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?”
verses.kjv: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

verses.web: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

verses.web: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
verses.kjv: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

verses.web: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
verses.kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.web: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
verses.kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

verses.web: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
verses.kjv: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

verses.web: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
verses.kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

verses.web: He rained also flesh on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.
verses.kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

verses.web: He let them fall in the midst of their camp, around their habitations.
verses.kjv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.web: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
verses.kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

verses.web: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
verses.kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

verses.web: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
verses.kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

verses.web: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
verses.kjv: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.web: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
verses.kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

verses.web: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
verses.kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

verses.web: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
verses.kjv: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

verses.web: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

verses.web: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
verses.kjv: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

verses.web: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
verses.kjv: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

verses.web: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
verses.kjv: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

verses.web: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
verses.kjv: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

verses.web: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

verses.web: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
verses.kjv: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

verses.web: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
verses.kjv: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

verses.web: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
verses.kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

verses.web: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.web: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
verses.kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

verses.web: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
verses.kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

verses.web: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.web: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
verses.kjv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

verses.web: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
verses.kjv: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.web: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
verses.kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

verses.web: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.web: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.web: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
verses.kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

verses.web: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.web: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies;
verses.kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

verses.web: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.kjv: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.web: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
verses.kjv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.web: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;
verses.kjv: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

verses.web: So that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.kjv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

verses.web: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
verses.kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.

verses.web: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
verses.kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.web: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
verses.kjv: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

verses.web: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
verses.kjv: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.web: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
verses.kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

verses.web: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.web: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
verses.kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.web: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
verses.kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

verses.web: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
verses.kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

verses.web: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.kjv: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.web: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
verses.kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

verses.web: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
verses.kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.web: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
verses.kjv: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

verses.web: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
verses.kjv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.web: Their blood they have shed like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
verses.kjv: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

verses.web: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
verses.kjv: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.web: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you; on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name;
verses.kjv: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

verses.web: For they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
verses.kjv: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

verses.web: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
verses.kjv: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

verses.web: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
verses.kjv: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.

verses.web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
verses.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

verses.web: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
verses.kjv: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

verses.web: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
verses.kjv: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

verses.web: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
verses.kjv: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

verses.web: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
verses.kjv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

verses.web: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
verses.kjv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

verses.web: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.web: Yahweh God of Armies, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
verses.kjv: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

verses.web: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
verses.kjv: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.web: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.kjv: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.web: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.web: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
verses.kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.web: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
verses.kjv: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.web: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
verses.kjv: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

verses.web: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.
verses.kjv: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

verses.web: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
verses.kjv: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.web: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
verses.kjv: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

verses.web: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
verses.kjv: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

verses.web: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
verses.kjv: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.web: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
verses.kjv: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.web: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
verses.kjv: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.web: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
verses.kjv: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.web: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.kjv: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.web: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
verses.kjv: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

verses.web: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
verses.kjv: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

verses.web: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
verses.kjv: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

verses.web: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.kjv: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

verses.web: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
verses.kjv: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

verses.web: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
verses.kjv: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

verses.web: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.
verses.kjv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

verses.web: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
verses.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

verses.web: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
verses.kjv: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

verses.web: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.web: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
verses.kjv: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

verses.web: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
verses.kjv: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

verses.web: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
verses.kjv: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

verses.web: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
verses.kjv: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

verses.web: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
verses.kjv: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

verses.web: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
verses.kjv: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

verses.web: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
verses.kjv: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

verses.web: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
verses.kjv: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

verses.web: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
verses.kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

verses.web: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
verses.kjv: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.web: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.kjv: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

verses.web: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
verses.kjv: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

verses.web: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
verses.kjv: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

verses.web: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
verses.kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

verses.web: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
verses.kjv: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

verses.web: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

verses.web: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
verses.kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

verses.web: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
verses.kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

verses.web: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
verses.kjv: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

verses.web: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
verses.kjv: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.web: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.kjv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.web: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.kjv: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

verses.web: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
verses.kjv: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

verses.web: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
verses.kjv: Which perished at En–dor: they became as dung for the earth.

verses.web: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;
verses.kjv: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

verses.web: who said, “Let us take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
verses.kjv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

verses.web: My God, make them like tumbleweed; like chaff before the wind.
verses.kjv: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

verses.web: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
verses.kjv: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

verses.web: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
verses.kjv: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

verses.web: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.

verses.web: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

verses.web: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.kjv: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.

verses.web: How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
verses.kjv: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!

verses.web: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.kjv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

verses.web: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.
verses.kjv: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.

verses.web: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.
verses.kjv: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

verses.web: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

verses.web: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
verses.kjv: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

verses.web: They go from strength to strength. Everyone of them appears before God in Zion.
verses.kjv: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

verses.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.kjv: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

verses.web: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
verses.kjv: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

verses.web: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.kjv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.web: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
verses.kjv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.web: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
verses.kjv: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

verses.web: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
verses.kjv: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

verses.web: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.kjv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

verses.web: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
verses.kjv: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

verses.web: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
verses.kjv: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

verses.web: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
verses.kjv: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

verses.web: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
verses.kjv: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

verses.web: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
verses.kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

verses.web: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.kjv: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.web: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.kjv: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.web: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.web: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
verses.kjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

verses.web: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
verses.kjv: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

verses.web: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.
verses.kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

verses.web: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

verses.web: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
verses.kjv: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

verses.web: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

verses.web: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.web: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
verses.kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

verses.web: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
verses.kjv: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

verses.web: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

verses.web: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
verses.kjv: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

verses.web: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
verses.kjv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

verses.web: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
verses.kjv: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

verses.web: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
verses.kjv: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

verses.web: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

verses.web: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
verses.kjv: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

verses.web: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
verses.kjv: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

verses.web: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
verses.kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

verses.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your handmaid.
verses.kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

verses.web: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
verses.kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

verses.web: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.kjv: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.web: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.kjv: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.web: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
verses.kjv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

verses.web: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
verses.kjv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

verses.web: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her”; the Most High himself will establish her.
verses.kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

verses.web: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
verses.kjv: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

verses.web: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
verses.kjv: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

verses.web: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
verses.kjv: O Lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

verses.web: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
verses.kjv: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

verses.web: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
verses.kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

verses.web: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
verses.kjv: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

verses.web: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
verses.kjv: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

verses.web: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
verses.kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

verses.web: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
verses.kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

verses.web: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
verses.kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

verses.web: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
verses.kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

verses.web: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.
verses.kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

verses.web: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
verses.kjv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

verses.web: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.web: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.
verses.kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

verses.web: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
verses.kjv: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

verses.web: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
verses.kjv: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

verses.web: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
verses.kjv: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

verses.web: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
verses.kjv: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

verses.web: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
verses.kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

verses.web: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
verses.kjv: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

verses.web: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
verses.kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

verses.web: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
verses.kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

verses.web: ‘I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
verses.kjv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

verses.web: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

verses.web: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
verses.kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?

verses.web: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
verses.kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

verses.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
verses.kjv: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

verses.web: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
verses.kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

verses.web: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
verses.kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

verses.web: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
verses.kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

verses.web: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
verses.kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

verses.web: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
verses.kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

verses.web: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
verses.kjv: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

verses.web: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.

verses.web: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
verses.kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

verses.web: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
verses.kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

verses.web: For our shield belongs to Yahweh; our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.kjv: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

verses.web: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have bestowed strength on the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
verses.kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.web: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
verses.kjv: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

verses.web: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
verses.kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.web: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
verses.kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.web: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
verses.kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

verses.web: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
verses.kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.web: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
verses.kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.web: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
verses.kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.web: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.web: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
verses.kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.web: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.kjv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.web: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
verses.kjv: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

verses.web: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
verses.kjv: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

verses.web: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.web: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

verses.web: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
verses.kjv: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

verses.web: Once have I sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
verses.kjv: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

verses.web: His seed will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
verses.kjv: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

verses.web: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
verses.kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

verses.web: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

verses.web: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
verses.kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

verses.web: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

verses.web: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.web: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
verses.kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.web: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.web: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
verses.kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.web: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

verses.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
verses.kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.web: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!
verses.kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

verses.web: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
verses.kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

verses.web: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
verses.kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

verses.web: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
verses.kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

verses.web: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
verses.kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

verses.web: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
verses.kjv: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

verses.web: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
verses.kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

verses.web: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
verses.kjv: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

verses.web: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
verses.kjv: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

verses.web: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
verses.kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

verses.web: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
verses.kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

verses.web: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
verses.kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

verses.web: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
verses.kjv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

verses.web: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
verses.kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

verses.web: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
verses.kjv: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

verses.web: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
verses.kjv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

verses.web: So teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verses.kjv: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

verses.web: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
verses.kjv: Return, O Lord, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

verses.web: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.web: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
verses.kjv: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

verses.web: Let your work appear to your servants; your glory to their children.
verses.kjv: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

verses.web: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.
verses.kjv: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

verses.web: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.web: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
verses.kjv: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

verses.web: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
verses.kjv: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

verses.web: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
verses.kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

verses.web: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;
verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

verses.web: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
verses.kjv: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

verses.web: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
verses.kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.web: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

verses.web: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
verses.kjv: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

verses.web: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
verses.kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

verses.web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
verses.kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.web: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
verses.kjv: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.web: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

verses.web: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
verses.kjv: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

verses.web: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
verses.kjv: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

verses.web: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
verses.kjv: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

verses.web: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High;
verses.kjv: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

verses.web: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
verses.kjv: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

verses.web: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
verses.kjv: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

verses.web: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
verses.kjv: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

verses.web: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.kjv: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.web: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
verses.kjv: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

verses.web: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
verses.kjv: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

verses.web: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
verses.kjv: But thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.

verses.web: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.web: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
verses.kjv: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.web: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
verses.kjv: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

verses.web: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.web: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
verses.kjv: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.web: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verses.kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

verses.web: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.kjv: To shew that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

verses.web: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
verses.kjv: The Lord reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

verses.web: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
verses.kjv: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

verses.web: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
verses.kjv: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

verses.web: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
verses.kjv: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

verses.web: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.

verses.web: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
verses.kjv: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

verses.web: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
verses.kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

verses.web: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
verses.kjv: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.web: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
verses.kjv: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

verses.web: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.
verses.kjv: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.

verses.web: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
verses.kjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.web: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
verses.kjv: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

verses.web: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
verses.kjv: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

verses.web: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
verses.kjv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.web: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
verses.kjv: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

verses.web: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
verses.kjv: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.web: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law;
verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;

verses.web: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.web: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.kjv: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.web: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.kjv: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.web: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
verses.kjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.web: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
verses.kjv: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

verses.web: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
verses.kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.

verses.web: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
verses.kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.web: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
verses.kjv: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

verses.web: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.kjv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.web: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
verses.kjv: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

verses.web: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
