verses.kjv: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.

verses.web: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
verses.kjv: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

verses.web: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
verses.kjv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

verses.web: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.
verses.kjv: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

verses.web: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
verses.kjv: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

verses.web: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
verses.kjv: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

verses.web: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
verses.kjv: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker.

verses.web: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
verses.kjv: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.web: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.kjv: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.web: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
verses.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

verses.web: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
verses.kjv: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

verses.web: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
verses.kjv: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

verses.web: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
verses.kjv: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.

verses.web: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
verses.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

verses.web: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
verses.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

verses.web: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.kjv: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
verses.kjv: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

verses.web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.kjv: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

verses.web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
verses.kjv: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

verses.web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

verses.web: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.kjv: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

verses.web: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.kjv: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

verses.web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
verses.kjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

verses.web: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
verses.kjv: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

verses.web: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
verses.kjv: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

verses.web: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
verses.kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

verses.web: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.kjv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

verses.web: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
verses.kjv: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

verses.web: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
verses.kjv: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.web: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.kjv: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.web: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

verses.web: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
verses.kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

verses.web: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced, because of your judgments, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O Lord.

verses.web: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.kjv: For thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.web: You who love Yahweh, hate evil. He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.kjv: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.web: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.kjv: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.web: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
verses.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.web: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand, and his holy arm, have worked salvation for him.
verses.kjv: O sing unto the Lord a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

verses.web: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.kjv: The Lord hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

verses.web: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.web: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

verses.web: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.kjv: Sing unto the Lord with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

verses.web: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.

verses.web: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
verses.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.web: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
verses.kjv: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

verses.web: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
verses.kjv: Before the Lord; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

verses.web: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
verses.kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

verses.web: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
verses.kjv: The Lord is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

verses.web: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
verses.kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

verses.web: The King’s strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.kjv: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.web: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
verses.kjv: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

verses.web: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; they called on Yahweh, and he answered them.
verses.kjv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he answered them.

verses.web: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
verses.kjv: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

verses.web: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
verses.kjv: Thou answeredst them, O Lord our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

verses.web: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
verses.kjv: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.

verses.web: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.

verses.web: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
verses.kjv: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

verses.web: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.kjv: Know ye that the Lord he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.web: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
verses.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

verses.web: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
verses.kjv: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

verses.web: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
verses.kjv: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.

verses.web: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
verses.kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.web: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
verses.kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

verses.web: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
verses.kjv: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

verses.web: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is haughty and conceited.
verses.kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

verses.web: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
verses.kjv: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

verses.web: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
verses.kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

verses.web: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
verses.kjv: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the Lord.

verses.web: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.

verses.web: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
verses.kjv: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

verses.web: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
verses.kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

verses.web: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
verses.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

verses.web: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
verses.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

verses.web: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

verses.web: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
verses.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

verses.web: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
verses.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

verses.web: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
verses.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.web: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.
verses.kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

verses.web: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
verses.kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

verses.web: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
verses.kjv: But thou, O Lord, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

verses.web: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

verses.web: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
verses.kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

verses.web: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name; all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

verses.web: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
verses.kjv: When the Lord shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

verses.web: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
verses.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

verses.web: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.
verses.kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.

verses.web: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
verses.kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;

verses.web: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;
verses.kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

verses.web: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.kjv: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.web: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
verses.kjv: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.

verses.web: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
verses.kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

verses.web: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the midst of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

verses.web: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

verses.web: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
verses.kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

verses.web: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
verses.kjv: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

verses.web: The children of your servants will continue. Their seed will be established before you.”
verses.kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

verses.web: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
verses.kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

verses.web: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits;
verses.kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.web: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;
verses.kjv: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

verses.web: who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;
verses.kjv: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.web: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.kjv: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.web: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
verses.kjv: The Lord executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

verses.web: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

verses.web: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
verses.kjv: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

verses.web: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
verses.kjv: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

verses.web: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
verses.kjv: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.web: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
verses.kjv: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

verses.web: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.kjv: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.web: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
verses.kjv: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth them that fear him.

verses.web: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
verses.kjv: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

verses.web: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
verses.kjv: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.web: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
verses.kjv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

verses.web: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children;
verses.kjv: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

verses.web: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
verses.kjv: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

verses.web: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
verses.kjv: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.web: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
verses.kjv: Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

verses.web: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
verses.kjv: Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

verses.web: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
verses.kjv: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.

verses.web: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
verses.kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

verses.web: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.kjv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.web: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
verses.kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

verses.web: He makes his messengers winds; his servants flames of fire.
verses.kjv: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

verses.web: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
verses.kjv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

verses.web: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.web: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
verses.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

verses.web: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
verses.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

verses.web: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
verses.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

verses.web: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
verses.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

verses.web: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

verses.web: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
verses.kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

verses.web: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
verses.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

verses.web: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
verses.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

verses.web: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
verses.kjv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

verses.web: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
verses.kjv: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

verses.web: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the fir trees.
verses.kjv: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

verses.web: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.kjv: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

verses.web: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
verses.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.web: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
verses.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

verses.web: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
verses.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

verses.web: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lay down in their dens.
verses.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

verses.web: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
verses.kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.web: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
verses.kjv: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

verses.web: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
verses.kjv: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

verses.web: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
verses.kjv: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

verses.web: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
verses.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

verses.web: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
verses.kjv: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

verses.web: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.
verses.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

verses.web: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
verses.kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

verses.web: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
verses.kjv: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

verses.web: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

verses.web: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.kjv: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.web: Let your meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verses.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.

verses.web: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
verses.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

verses.web: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
verses.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

verses.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
verses.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

verses.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
verses.kjv: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

verses.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.web: you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

verses.web: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.kjv: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.web: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
verses.kjv: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

verses.web: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

verses.web: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance”;
verses.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

verses.web: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
verses.kjv: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

verses.web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.kjv: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

verses.web: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

verses.web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
verses.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.web: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
verses.kjv: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

verses.web: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
verses.kjv: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

verses.web: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
verses.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

verses.web: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
verses.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.

verses.web: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
verses.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

verses.web: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;
verses.kjv: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

verses.web: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
verses.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

verses.web: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
verses.kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

verses.web: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
verses.kjv: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

verses.web: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
verses.kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

verses.web: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.kjv: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

verses.web: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.kjv: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.web: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
verses.kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

verses.web: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
verses.kjv: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.web: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
verses.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.web: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
verses.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

verses.web: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
verses.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.web: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
verses.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

verses.web: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,
verses.kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

verses.web: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.
verses.kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.web: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
verses.kjv: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.web: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
verses.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

verses.web: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
verses.kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

verses.web: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
verses.kjv: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.web: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
verses.kjv: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

verses.web: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
verses.kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

verses.web: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
verses.kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

verses.web: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
verses.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

verses.web: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
verses.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

verses.web: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
verses.kjv: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.web: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?
verses.kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?

verses.web: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
verses.kjv: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

verses.web: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
verses.kjv: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

verses.web: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
verses.kjv: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

verses.web: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
verses.kjv: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.web: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
verses.kjv: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

verses.web: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

verses.web: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
verses.kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

verses.web: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.kjv: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.web: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
verses.kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

verses.web: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
verses.kjv: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

verses.web: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
verses.kjv: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

verses.web: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
verses.kjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

verses.web: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.kjv: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.web: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.
verses.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.

verses.web: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.kjv: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.web: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
verses.kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.web: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
verses.kjv: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

verses.web: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
verses.kjv: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

verses.web: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.kjv: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

verses.web: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
verses.kjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

verses.web: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
verses.kjv: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

verses.web: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
verses.kjv: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

verses.web: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.
verses.kjv: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.

verses.web: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.kjv: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

verses.web: that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
verses.kjv: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

verses.web: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.kjv: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.web: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
verses.kjv: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

verses.web: Then Phinehas stood up, and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
verses.kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

verses.web: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
verses.kjv: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

verses.web: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
verses.kjv: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

verses.web: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.kjv: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

verses.web: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,
verses.kjv: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:

verses.web: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
verses.kjv: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

verses.web: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
verses.kjv: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

verses.web: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
verses.kjv: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

verses.web: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
verses.kjv: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.web: Thus were they defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
verses.kjv: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

verses.web: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
verses.kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

verses.web: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.kjv: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.web: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.kjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

verses.web: Many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
verses.kjv: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

verses.web: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

verses.web: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
verses.kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.web: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
verses.kjv: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

verses.web: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
verses.kjv: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
verses.kjv: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

verses.web: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
verses.kjv: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

verses.web: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
verses.kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.web: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.kjv: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,
verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.web: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
verses.kjv: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.web: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
verses.kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

verses.web: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
verses.kjv: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

verses.web: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.kjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

verses.web: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
verses.kjv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

verses.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.web: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
verses.kjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.web: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.
verses.kjv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.web: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
verses.kjv: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

verses.web: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
verses.kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

verses.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.
verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

verses.web: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
verses.kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.web: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with singing.
verses.kjv: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

verses.web: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
verses.kjv: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

verses.web: These see Yahweh’s works, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.kjv: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

verses.web: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
verses.kjv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

verses.web: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
verses.kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

verses.web: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
verses.kjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

verses.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

verses.web: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
verses.kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

verses.web: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
verses.kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works for the children of men!
verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.web: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
verses.kjv: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

verses.web: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
verses.kjv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

verses.web: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.web: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
verses.kjv: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

verses.web: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
verses.kjv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

verses.web: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
verses.kjv: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

verses.web: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
verses.kjv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

verses.web: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.kjv: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

verses.web: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
verses.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

verses.web: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
verses.kjv: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

verses.web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.web: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.

verses.web: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
verses.kjv: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

verses.web: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
verses.kjv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.web: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

verses.web: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.kjv: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

verses.web: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.web: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
verses.kjv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.web: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
verses.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.web: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?
verses.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.web: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
verses.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

verses.web: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.web: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.
verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.web: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
verses.kjv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.web: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
verses.kjv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.web: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
verses.kjv: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.web: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
verses.kjv: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

verses.web: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.kjv: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.web: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.kjv: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.web: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.kjv: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

verses.web: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
verses.kjv: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

verses.web: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.kjv: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.web: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
verses.kjv: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

verses.web: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
verses.kjv: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.web: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
verses.kjv: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.web: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.kjv: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.web: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.kjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.web: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
verses.kjv: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.web: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
verses.kjv: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.web: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
verses.kjv: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.web: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
verses.kjv: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.web: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
verses.kjv: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.web: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
verses.kjv: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.web: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
verses.kjv: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

verses.web: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
verses.kjv: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.web: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.kjv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.web: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
verses.kjv: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.web: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.kjv: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.web: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
verses.kjv: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.web: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
verses.kjv: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.

verses.web: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
verses.kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.web: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
verses.kjv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.web: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.kjv: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.web: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
verses.kjv: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

verses.web: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
verses.kjv: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.web: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of your enemies.
verses.kjv: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.web: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
verses.kjv: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

verses.web: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.kjv: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.web: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.kjv: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.web: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
verses.kjv: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

verses.web: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
verses.kjv: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

verses.web: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.web: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
verses.kjv: The works of the Lord are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

verses.web: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.kjv: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.web: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
verses.kjv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.web: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
verses.kjv: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.web: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.kjv: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.web: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
verses.kjv: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

verses.web: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.kjv: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.web: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
verses.kjv: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

verses.web: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

verses.web: His seed will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.kjv: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.web: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.kjv: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.web: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
verses.kjv: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.web: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.kjv: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

verses.web: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
verses.kjv: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.web: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
verses.kjv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.

verses.web: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
verses.kjv: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

verses.web: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
verses.kjv: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

verses.web: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
verses.kjv: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.web: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.web: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
verses.kjv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord’s name is to be praised.

verses.web: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
verses.kjv: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

verses.web: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
verses.kjv: Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,

verses.web: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
verses.kjv: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.web: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;
verses.kjv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.web: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.kjv: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

verses.web: He settles the barren woman in her home, as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
verses.kjv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.web: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language;
verses.kjv: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.web: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.kjv: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

verses.web: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
verses.kjv: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

verses.web: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
verses.kjv: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

verses.web: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.kjv: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

verses.web: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?
verses.kjv: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

verses.web: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.kjv: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

verses.web: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
verses.kjv: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

verses.web: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
verses.kjv: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.

verses.web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
verses.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

verses.web: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
verses.kjv: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

verses.web: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.kjv: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.web: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
verses.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

verses.web: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
verses.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

verses.web: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
verses.kjv: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

verses.web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.kjv: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

verses.web: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
verses.kjv: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.web: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
verses.kjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.web: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
verses.kjv: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.web: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.kjv: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.web: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
verses.kjv: He will bless them that fear the Lord, both small and great.

verses.web: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.kjv: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.web: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
verses.kjv: Ye are blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.

verses.web: The heavens are the heavens of Yahweh; but the earth has he given to the children of men.
verses.kjv: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

verses.web: The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;
verses.kjv: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.

verses.web: But we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
verses.kjv: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.

verses.web: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
verses.kjv: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

verses.web: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.kjv: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

verses.web: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.web: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
verses.kjv: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

verses.web: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
verses.kjv: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

verses.web: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
verses.kjv: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

verses.web: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.web: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.web: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
verses.kjv: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.web: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
verses.kjv: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

verses.web: I said in my haste, “All men are liars.”
verses.kjv: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

verses.web: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
verses.kjv: What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

verses.web: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
verses.kjv: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.

verses.web: Precious in the sight of Yahweh is the death of his saints.
verses.kjv: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

verses.web: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your handmaid. You have freed me from my chains.
verses.kjv: O Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

verses.web: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
verses.kjv: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,
verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people,

verses.web: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
