verses.kjv: In the courts of the Lord’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.web: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
verses.kjv: O praise the Lord, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

verses.web: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
verses.kjv: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
verses.kjv: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me, and set me in a large place.

verses.web: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.kjv: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

verses.web: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
verses.kjv: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

verses.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
verses.kjv: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.

verses.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
verses.kjv: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.

verses.web: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
verses.kjv: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.

verses.web: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
verses.kjv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

verses.web: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
verses.kjv: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

verses.web: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
verses.kjv: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

verses.web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
verses.kjv: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.web: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
verses.kjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

verses.web: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
verses.kjv: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

verses.web: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
verses.kjv: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

verses.web: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.kjv: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

verses.web: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
verses.kjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:

verses.web: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
verses.kjv: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.web: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

verses.web: The stone which the builders rejected has become the head of the corner.
verses.kjv: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

verses.web: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.kjv: This is the Lord’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.web: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
verses.kjv: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.web: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
verses.kjv: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

verses.web: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
verses.kjv: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

verses.web: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.kjv: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.web: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.kjv: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

verses.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
verses.kjv: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.

verses.web: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
verses.kjv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

verses.web: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
verses.kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

verses.web: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
verses.kjv: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

verses.web: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
verses.kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

verses.web: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
verses.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

verses.web: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

verses.web: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.
verses.kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

verses.web: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
verses.kjv: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

verses.web: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
verses.kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

verses.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

verses.web: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
verses.kjv: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.

verses.web: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
verses.kjv: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

verses.web: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.kjv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.web: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
verses.kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

verses.web: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
verses.kjv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

verses.web: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
verses.kjv: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

verses.web: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
verses.kjv: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

verses.web: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
verses.kjv: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

verses.web: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
verses.kjv: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

verses.web: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
verses.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

verses.web: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
verses.kjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

verses.web: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.kjv: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

verses.web: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

verses.web: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
verses.kjv: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

verses.web: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
verses.kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

verses.web: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

verses.web: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
verses.kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

verses.web: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
verses.kjv: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

verses.web: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
verses.kjv: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

verses.web: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
verses.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

verses.web: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
verses.kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

verses.web: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
verses.kjv: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

verses.web: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
verses.kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

verses.web: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
verses.kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.web: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
verses.kjv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.web: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
verses.kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

verses.web: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
verses.kjv: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

verses.web: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
verses.kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

verses.web: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
verses.kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

verses.web: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
verses.kjv: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

verses.web: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
verses.kjv: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

verses.web: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
verses.kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

verses.web: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
verses.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

verses.web: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

verses.web: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
verses.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.web: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
verses.kjv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.web: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
verses.kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

verses.web: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
verses.kjv: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

verses.web: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
verses.kjv: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

verses.web: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
verses.kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

verses.web: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.
verses.kjv: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.

verses.web: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
verses.kjv: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

verses.web: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.
verses.kjv: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.web: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.
verses.kjv: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.

verses.web: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.
verses.kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

verses.web: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
verses.kjv: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.

verses.web: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
verses.kjv: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

verses.web: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
verses.kjv: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

verses.web: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
verses.kjv: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

verses.web: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
verses.kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.web: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.web: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
verses.kjv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

verses.web: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
verses.kjv: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

verses.web: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.

verses.web: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
verses.kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

verses.web: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
verses.kjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

verses.web: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
verses.kjv: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

verses.web: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
verses.kjv: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

verses.web: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
verses.kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

verses.web: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
verses.kjv: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

verses.web: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
verses.kjv: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.web: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
verses.kjv: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

verses.web: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
verses.kjv: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

verses.web: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.kjv: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

verses.web: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
verses.kjv: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

verses.web: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
verses.kjv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

verses.web: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

verses.web: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
verses.kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

verses.web: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
verses.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

verses.web: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
verses.kjv: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

verses.web: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

verses.web: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
verses.kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

verses.web: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.kjv: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.web: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
verses.kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

verses.web: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
verses.kjv: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

verses.web: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
verses.kjv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

verses.web: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
verses.kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

verses.web: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
verses.kjv: For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.

verses.web: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
verses.kjv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

verses.web: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
verses.kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

verses.web: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.kjv: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

verses.web: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
verses.kjv: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

verses.web: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.kjv: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

verses.web: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
verses.kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

verses.web: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
verses.kjv: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

verses.web: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
verses.kjv: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

verses.web: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
verses.kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

verses.web: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.kjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

verses.web: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
verses.kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

verses.web: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
verses.kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

verses.web: I have not turned aside from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
verses.kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

verses.web: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
verses.kjv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.web: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
verses.kjv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

verses.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
verses.kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.web: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
verses.kjv: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

verses.web: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
verses.kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.

verses.web: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
verses.kjv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.

verses.web: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
verses.kjv: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.web: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
verses.kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

verses.web: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.web: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.
verses.kjv: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

verses.web: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
verses.kjv: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

verses.web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
verses.kjv: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

verses.web: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.web: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.web: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
verses.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

verses.web: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
verses.kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

verses.web: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.kjv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

verses.web: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
verses.kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

verses.web: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
verses.kjv: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

verses.web: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
verses.kjv: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.web: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

verses.web: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
verses.kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

verses.web: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
verses.kjv: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.web: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
verses.kjv: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.

verses.web: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
verses.kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.web: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
verses.kjv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

verses.web: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

verses.web: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.kjv: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

verses.web: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
verses.kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

verses.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.kjv: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

verses.web: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.web: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
verses.kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

verses.web: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

verses.web: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.
verses.kjv: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

verses.web: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
verses.kjv: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.

verses.web: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

verses.web: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
verses.kjv: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

verses.web: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
verses.kjv: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

verses.web: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
verses.kjv: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

verses.web: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
verses.kjv: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

verses.web: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
verses.kjv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

verses.web: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
verses.kjv: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.web: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
verses.kjv: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.

verses.web: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
verses.kjv: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

verses.web: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
verses.kjv: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

verses.web: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
verses.kjv: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

verses.web: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
verses.kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.web: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
verses.kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

verses.web: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
verses.kjv: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.

verses.web: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
verses.kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

verses.web: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
verses.kjv: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.web: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
verses.kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

verses.web: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
verses.kjv: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

verses.web: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
verses.kjv: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.

verses.web: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
verses.kjv: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

verses.web: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
verses.kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

verses.web: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
verses.kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.

verses.web: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
verses.kjv: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

verses.web: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
verses.kjv: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

verses.web: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
verses.kjv: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

verses.web: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
verses.kjv: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

verses.web: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.web: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
verses.kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

verses.web: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
verses.kjv: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

verses.web: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
verses.kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.web: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.
verses.kjv: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

verses.web: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.
verses.kjv: Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.

verses.web: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
verses.kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

verses.web: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
verses.kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

verses.web: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
verses.kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

verses.web: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.kjv: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

verses.web: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
verses.kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.

verses.web: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
verses.kjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

verses.web: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
verses.kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

verses.web: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
verses.kjv: In my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.

verses.web: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.kjv: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.web: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
verses.kjv: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

verses.web: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.kjv: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.web: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.web: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
verses.kjv: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

verses.web: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.kjv: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

verses.web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
verses.kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

verses.web: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
verses.kjv: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

verses.web: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.web: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.kjv: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.web: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
verses.kjv: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.web: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.web: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
verses.kjv: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.web: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
verses.kjv: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

verses.web: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
verses.kjv: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.

verses.web: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem;
verses.kjv: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.web: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together;
verses.kjv: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.web: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
verses.kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

verses.web: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
verses.kjv: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.web: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
verses.kjv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.web: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.kjv: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.web: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
verses.kjv: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

verses.web: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
verses.kjv: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.

verses.web: To you I do lift up my eyes, you who sit in the heavens.
verses.kjv: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

verses.web: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.
verses.kjv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.web: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
verses.kjv: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.web: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
verses.kjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

verses.web: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
verses.kjv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

verses.web: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;
verses.kjv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.web: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;
verses.kjv: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.web: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
verses.kjv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.web: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
verses.kjv: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.web: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.kjv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.web: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
verses.kjv: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.web: Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
verses.kjv: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

verses.web: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
verses.kjv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.web: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
verses.kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.web: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
verses.kjv: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

verses.web: But as for those who turn aside to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
verses.kjv: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

verses.web: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.kjv: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

verses.web: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”
verses.kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.web: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
verses.kjv: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

verses.web: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.
verses.kjv: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.

verses.web: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verses.kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.web: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
verses.kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

verses.web: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
verses.kjv: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.web: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
verses.kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.web: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.kjv: Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

verses.web: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
verses.kjv: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

verses.web: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.kjv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.web: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
verses.kjv: Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.

verses.web: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
verses.kjv: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.web: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants, around your table.
verses.kjv: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.web: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.

verses.web: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.kjv: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.web: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Israel.

verses.web: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,
verses.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

verses.web: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.web: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
verses.kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.web: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
verses.kjv: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.web: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
verses.kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.web: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up;
verses.kjv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

verses.web: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
verses.kjv: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

verses.web: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
verses.kjv: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.

verses.web: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.

verses.web: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
verses.kjv: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.web: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
verses.kjv: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

verses.web: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
verses.kjv: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

verses.web: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
verses.kjv: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.web: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning; more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.kjv: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

verses.web: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for with Yahweh there is loving kindness. With him is abundant redemption.
verses.kjv: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.web: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.kjv: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

verses.web: Yahweh, my heart isn’t haughty, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
verses.kjv: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

verses.web: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.kjv: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

verses.web: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.kjv: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.

verses.web: Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
verses.kjv: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:

verses.web: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.kjv: How he sware unto the Lord, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

verses.web: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.kjv: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.web: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;
verses.kjv: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

verses.web: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.kjv: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

verses.web: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar:
verses.kjv: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.web: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.
verses.kjv: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.web: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place; you, and the ark of your strength.
verses.kjv: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.web: Let your priest be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”
verses.kjv: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

verses.web: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
verses.kjv: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

verses.web: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
verses.kjv: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.web: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
verses.kjv: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

verses.web: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
verses.kjv: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

verses.web: “This is my resting place forever. Here I will live, for I have desired it.
verses.kjv: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.web: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.kjv: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.web: Her priests I will also clothe with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
verses.kjv: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.web: There I will make the horn of David to bud. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
verses.kjv: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

verses.web: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will be resplendent.”
verses.kjv: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

verses.web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
verses.kjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.web: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard; that came down on the edge of his robes;
verses.kjv: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

verses.web: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion: for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
verses.kjv: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

verses.web: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
verses.kjv: Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.

verses.web: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
verses.kjv: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.

verses.web: May Yahweh bless you from Zion; even he who made heaven and earth.
verses.kjv: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

verses.web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
verses.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.

verses.web: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
verses.kjv: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God,

verses.web: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
verses.kjv: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

verses.web: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself; Israel for his own possession.
verses.kjv: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

verses.web: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.kjv: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.web: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
verses.kjv: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.web: who causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth; who makes lightnings with the rain; who brings the wind out of his treasuries;
verses.kjv: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.web: Who struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal;
verses.kjv: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

verses.web: Who sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants;
verses.kjv: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

verses.web: who struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
verses.kjv: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.web: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
verses.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

verses.web: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
verses.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.web: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
verses.kjv: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.

verses.web: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants.
verses.kjv: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.web: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.kjv: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.web: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
verses.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.web: They have ears, but they can’t hear; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.kjv: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

verses.web: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
verses.kjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:

verses.web: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
verses.kjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, Who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Give thanks to the God of gods; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who by understanding made the heavens; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who spread out the earth above the waters; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: The sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: The moon and stars to rule by night; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: And brought out Israel from among them; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: And made Israel to pass through its midst; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who led his people through the wilderness; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: To him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: And killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: Og king of Bashan; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: And gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: Even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.web: And has delivered us from our adversaries; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.kjv: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.kjv: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

verses.web: On the willows in its midst, we hung up our harps.
verses.kjv: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

verses.web: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
verses.kjv: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

verses.web: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?
verses.kjv: How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a strange land?

verses.web: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
verses.kjv: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

verses.web: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you; if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.kjv: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

verses.web: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom, the day of Jerusalem; who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
verses.kjv: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

verses.web: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who rewards you, as you have served us.
verses.kjv: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

verses.web: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
verses.kjv: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

verses.web: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.web: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
verses.kjv: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

verses.web: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
verses.kjv: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

verses.web: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
verses.kjv: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

verses.web: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh; for great is Yahweh’s glory.
verses.kjv: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.web: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but the proud, he knows from afar.
verses.kjv: Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

verses.web: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
verses.kjv: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

verses.web: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
verses.kjv: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

verses.web: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
verses.kjv: O Lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.

verses.web: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
verses.kjv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

verses.web: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.kjv: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

verses.web: For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
verses.kjv: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.

verses.web: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
verses.kjv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

verses.web: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
verses.kjv: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

verses.web: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
verses.kjv: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

verses.web: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
verses.kjv: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

verses.web: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.kjv: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.web: Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
verses.kjv: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.web: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me; the light around me will be night”;
verses.kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

verses.web: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
verses.kjv: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

verses.web: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.

verses.web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

verses.web: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
verses.kjv: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.web: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
verses.kjv: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

verses.web: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
verses.kjv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

verses.web: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
verses.kjv: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

verses.web: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
verses.kjv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

verses.web: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
verses.kjv: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

verses.web: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
verses.kjv: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

verses.web: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
verses.kjv: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

verses.web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
verses.kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

verses.web: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
verses.kjv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

verses.web: Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man;
verses.kjv: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

verses.web: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
verses.kjv: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

verses.web: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.kjv: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.

verses.web: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
verses.kjv: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

verses.web: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
verses.kjv: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

verses.web: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.
verses.kjv: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.

verses.web: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.kjv: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.web: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
verses.kjv: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.web: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.kjv: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.web: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
verses.kjv: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

verses.web: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.kjv: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

verses.web: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
verses.kjv: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

verses.web: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
verses.kjv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

verses.web: Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
verses.kjv: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

verses.web: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
verses.kjv: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

verses.web: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
verses.kjv: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

verses.web: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
verses.kjv: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

verses.web: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
verses.kjv: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

verses.web: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
verses.kjv: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

verses.web: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
verses.kjv: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

verses.web: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
verses.kjv: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

verses.web: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
verses.kjv: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

verses.web: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, while I pass by.
verses.kjv: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

verses.web: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
verses.kjv: I cried unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.

verses.web: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
verses.kjv: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

verses.web: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
verses.kjv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

verses.web: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
verses.kjv: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

verses.web: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
verses.kjv: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.web: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. deliver me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than me.
verses.kjv: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

verses.web: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
verses.kjv: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

verses.web: Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

verses.web: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
verses.kjv: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

verses.web: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
verses.kjv: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

verses.web: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
verses.kjv: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

verses.web: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
verses.kjv: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

verses.web: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.
